verdict.rationale: Ultrametric ships its own skill file into projects through `ultrametric init`, which writes .agents/skills and .claude/skills SKILL.md. Nothing in the evidence shows a meta-skill or tool that guides an agent to write, improve, or package new skills. Installing a prebuilt skill is an adjacent feature, not skill authoring.

support.subject: As a developer, the collection ships a meta-skill or tool that guides my agent through writing, improving, and packaging new skills
